transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we get started, let's go through the current draft build package so we can get all department signoffs today. As it stands, we're looking at one 700 kg scenic platform, a red fabric backdrop, and a west-side camera entrance on Stage 4 for the musical number. I need each department to confirm they're good with this or flag any required changes before I issue the final build package to the scenic crew. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a required change before we proceed. After the draft package circulated, I received the stage engineer's revised floor-load map, and I haven't uploaded it to the build packet yet. The revised map shows that the planned 700 kg platform cannot be concentrated on one area. The approved alternative is three separate platforms with load spreaders, each carrying no more than 400 kg. So we'll need to update the build package to reflect that before scenic crew begins construction.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a required change on the fabric backdrop. I confirmed with our fabric supplier this morning that the only available backdrop material with the required flame-retardant certification is 180 meters of Slate Gray FR-7. The red fabric specified in the draft package has no current certification, so we'll need to update the backdrop to Slate Gray FR-7 before we can proceed. I'm still waiting on the purchase order, but the material availability and certification are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a required change on the camera entrance. My camera test after blocking showed that the crane needs a clear west-to-east lane 2.4 meters wide, so the scenic entrance must be on the east side, not the west side as called for in the draft. This test note is in my camera report but hasn't been added to the scenic drawings yet, so we'll need to update the build package to reflect an east-side entrance before construction begins.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Issue final build package reflecting three platforms with load spreaders (400 kg max each), Slate Gray FR-7 fabric backdrop (180 meters), and east-side camera entrance before construction begins.
Confirm purchase order for Slate Gray FR-7 fabric before final package is issued.
Add east-side entrance and 2.4-meter west-to-east camera lane to scenic drawings.
Upload revised floor-load map to the build packet.
